extraction.notes: Whole page read (page 1). The English version of the page carries no figures. This run's items: MDA-GOV-2024-003-0007 to MDA-GOV-2024-003-0017 (11 items: 8 interventions, 3 metrics; all theme: TECH-INTEROP, with TECH-DATA for the data principles and the Government Data Portal and TECH-DGOV for the once-only exchange). Alpha items 0001 to 0006 are unchanged; their passages are quoted again here. Left out: the list of "Beneficiile utilizării" (stated benefits in general terms, no claim of result); the lead-in and links on how to join the exchange (semantic.gov.md, mconnect.gov.md); navigation, calendar and attachment list. For the analyst, not resolved: over 2.6 million requests a day and 600 million exchanges in total are not reconciled on the page, and the 480+ count has no public and private split. The page metadata gives 2022 as creation date; the figures are labelled 2024. No Chapter 2 content. items.stated_text: Platforma Guvernamentală de Interoperabilitate (MConnect) este soluția tehnologică dezvoltată de Guvernul Republicii Moldova pentru a asigura interoperabilitatea și schimbul de date între sisteme informaționale. MConnect facilitează schimbul de date dintre autorități pentru creșterea eficienței și calității de prestare a serviciilor publice.

MConnect facilitates data exchange between authorities to increase the efficiency and quality of public service delivery.

items.stated_text: Gratuitatea Datelor – datele deținute de participanții publici sunt puse la dispoziție altor participanți publici în mod gratuit. Punerea la dispoziție a datelor deținute de participanții publici participanților privați este efectuată cu titlu oneros în cazurile prevăzute de legislație și în baza mecanismului stabilit de Guvern;
items.translation_en: Free data: data held by public participants are made available to other public participants free of charge. Data held by public participants are made available to private participants for a fee in the cases provided by law and on the basis of the mechanism set by the Government;
items.summary: Principle: public participants share data free of charge with each other; private participants pay in cases set by law.
items.extraction_note: Principle of the data exchange as listed on the page; the page does not say how far it is met in practice. Alpha item MDA-GOV-2024-003-0005 quoted the first sentence only.

pass2.classification_note: Data exchange principle; the paid reuse by private participants bears on re-use of public sector information

items.stated_text: Disponibilitatea Datelor – datele deținute de participanții la schimbul de date sunt disponibile în egală măsură pentru orice alt participant la schimbul de date, în baza mandatului legal al acestuia, cu asigurarea cerințelor de interoperabilitate juridică, organizatorică, semantică și tehnică. Participanții la schimbul de date sunt obligați să asigure disponibilitatea tuturor seturilor de date deținute;
items.translation_en: Data availability: data held by participants in the data exchange are equally available to any other participant on the basis of its legal mandate, while ensuring legal, organisational, semantic and technical interoperability requirements. Participants in the data exchange are obliged to ensure the availability of all data sets they hold;
items.summary: Principle: data are available to any participant with a legal mandate; participants must make all their data sets available.
items.extraction_note: Principle of the data exchange as listed on the page; the page does not say how far it is met in practice. The obligation in the second sentence was alpha item MDA-GOV-2024-003-0006.

pass2.classification_note: Data exchange principle and the obligation to make data sets available; not shown in practice

items.stated_text: Legalitatea Schimbului de Date – datele deținute de participanții la schimbul de date sunt furnizate prin platforma de interoperabilitate unui alt participant în condițiile în care acesta invocă un scop și un temei legal pentru prelucrarea setului de date solicitat și respectă cerințele de securitate și confidențialitate ce decurg din regimul juridic al datelor vizate;
items.translation_en: Legality of data exchange: data held by participants are provided through the interoperability platform to another participant where that participant invokes a purpose and a legal basis for processing the requested data set and complies with the security and confidentiality requirements arising from the legal regime of the data concerned;
items.summary: Principle: data are provided through the platform only for a stated purpose and legal basis, respecting security and confidentiality requirements.
items.extraction_note: Principle of the data exchange as listed on the page; the page does not say how far it is met in practice.

pass2.classification_note: Data exchange principle; not shown in practice

items.stated_text: Autenticitatea Datelor – datele din sistemele informaționale ale participanților la schimbul de date, furnizate prin intermediul platformei de interoperabilitate, se prezumă a fi autentice, se consideră integre și veridice și stau la baza actelor juridice, iar furnizorii de date sunt obligați să asigure integritatea și veridicitatea acestora;
items.translation_en: Authenticity of data: data from participants' information systems provided through the interoperability platform are presumed authentic, considered complete and truthful and form the basis of legal acts, and data providers are obliged to ensure their integrity and truthfulness;
items.summary: Principle: data provided through the platform are presumed authentic and can ground legal acts; providers must ensure their integrity.
